title_en: Call for Participants: National Science Museum Citizen Science Debate on Artificial Intelligence
summary: The National Science Museum invites participants to the Citizen Participatory Science Debate: Artificial Intelligence Edition, held on Saturday, 12 December 2026, from 13:00 to 15:00 in Narae Hall at the National Science Museum. Participation is optional and open to high school students and above, including adults. Interested persons must reserve a place in advance, free of charge, through the museum website (www.science.go.kr).
applies_to: Optional for anyone interested who is a high school student or above, up to and including adults. The notice does not limit participation by program, year of admission or nationality.

dates.what: Citizen Participatory Science Debate: Artificial Intelligence Edition, held at Narae Hall, National Science Museum

conditions: Advance reservation through the National Science Museum website is required to participate.
The event is open to high school students and above, including adults.
Participants who take part as panel members will receive a souvenir.
The notice does not state a reservation deadline.
steps: Make an advance reservation, free of charge, on the National Science Museum website (www.science.go.kr).
Attend the debate at Narae Hall, National Science Museum, on Saturday, 12 December 2026, from 13:00 to 15:00.
For questions, contact the Industrial Technology Team of the National Science Museum; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
National Science Museum: Call for Participants in the "Citizen Participatory Science Debate" [시민 참여형 과학 대토론회]

A. Event: Citizen Participatory Science Debate: Artificial Intelligence Edition

B. Topic: The human domain in the face of advancing artificial intelligence: [Shrinking VS Expanding]

C. Date, time and venue: Saturday, 12 December 2026, 13:00 to 15:00 / Narae Hall [나래홀], National Science Museum

D. How to participate: Advance reservation through the museum website (www.science.go.kr, free of charge)

E. Eligible participants: High school students and above, including adults. ※ Panel participants will receive a souvenir.

F. Enquiries: Industrial Technology Team, National Science Museum (the contact details are in the original notice).
